title: All-test-object compatible tuples of local module sections
statement: Let D be a category with Grothendieck topology K, let A be a sheaf of rings, and let U_i be a family of objects. On the localizations [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], let F_i be sheaves of A|U_i-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Gluing data consist of sectionwise additive transition equivalences for each pair W → U_i, W → U_j, linear over A(W), natural under every T → W, and satisfying the triple cocycle. For V, define the A(V)-module of tuples x_(i,W,f,a) in F_i(W → U_i), indexed by every span f:W → V, a:W → U_i, satisfying restriction and transition compatibility. Scalar multiplication uses A(f), and restriction along V′ → V precomposes f. Evaluation at the identity span over a local object and extension using transitions define mutually inverse linear maps, natural in that local object. These define a module presheaf and natural local identifications whenever the presheaf is a sheaf. All section types lie in a universe closed under the object, arrow and family-index universes.

No direct compatible-tuple module construction found.

The parent SiteModuleSheafGluing applies this auxiliary. Mathlib has type-valued sheaf gluing and abstract descent-data APIs, but no instantiated gluing of module sheaves on localizations. Presieve.IsSheafFor.amalgamate and local separatedness suffice for the coordinate construction.
